newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Ganadero target raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Banco Ganadero target raised.

text.p: ING Barings said it raised its price target on Banco Ganadero's common ADRs from $33.10 to $35.80 due to price appreciation since it initiated coverage of the bank, Colombia's largest in terms of assets.
The decision was partly based on expected 13.5 percent average book value growth before dividends during the 1997/98 period, Barings said in a statement.

The new price target represents an expected return of 19 percent, including a 4 percent dividend yield until December 1997, the statement said, adding that Barings reiterated its buy rating on the stock.
